entries.name: CohnElkies.harmonic_bottom_far_joint_tendsto_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {ℓ : ℝ}, 0 < ℓ → ∀ {b : ℝ → ℝ}, Continuous b → ∀ {A : ℝ}, 0 ≤ A → (∀ (y : ℝ), |b y| ≤ A * (1 + |y|)) → ∀ (s : ℝ) {δ : ℝ}, 0 < δ → Filter.Tendsto (fun z => ∫ (T : ℝ) in {T | δ ≤ |T|}, CohnElkies.stripPoissonKernel (z.im / ℓ) T * b (z.re - ℓ * T)) (nhdsWithin (↑s - Complex.I * ↑ℓ) (Complex.im ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-ℓ) ℓ)) (nhds 0)

entries.statement: ∀ {ℓ : ℝ}, 0 < ℓ → ∀ {b : ℝ → ℝ}, Continuous b → ∀ {A : ℝ}, 0 ≤ A → (∀ (y : ℝ), |b y| ≤ A * (1 + |y|)) → (∀ (t : ℝ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun T => CohnElkies.stripPoissonKernel 0 T * b (t - ℓ * T)) MeasureTheory.volume) → ∀ (s : ℝ), b s = 0 → Filter.Tendsto (fun z => ∫ (T : ℝ), CohnElkies.stripPoissonKernel (z.im / ℓ) T * b (z.re - ℓ * T)) (nhdsWithin (↑s - Complex.I * ↑ℓ) (Complex.im ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-ℓ) ℓ)) (nhds 0)

entries.name: CohnElkies.horizontalStripRealTraceExtension_continuousOn
entries.statement: ∀ {a b : ℝ}, a < b → ∀ (H : ℂ → ℝ) (bottom top : ℝ → ℝ), ContinuousOn H (Complex.im ⁻¹' Set.Ioo a b) → Continuous bottom → Continuous top → (∀ (s : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto H (nhdsWithin (↑s + Complex.I * ↑a) (Complex.im ⁻¹' Set.Ioo a b)) (nhds (bottom s))) → (∀ (s : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto H (nhdsWithin (↑s + Complex.I * ↑b) (Complex.im ⁻¹' Set.Ioo a b)) (nhds (top s))) → ContinuousOn (CohnElkies.horizontalStripRealTraceExtension a b H bottom top) (Complex.im ⁻¹' Set.Icc a b)

entries.name: CohnElkies.horizontalStrip_closed_eq_open_union_edges

entries.name: CohnElkies.horizontalStrip_norm_extension_majorization
entries.statement: ∀ {a b C : ℝ}, a < b → 0 < C → ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (N : ℂ → ℝ), DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Complex.im ⁻¹' Set.Ioo a b) → ContinuousOn N (Complex.im ⁻¹' Set.Icc a b) → (∀ (w : ℂ), w.im ∈ Set.Icc a b → 0 ≤ N w) → (∀ (w : ℂ), w.im ∈ Set.Ioo a b → N w = ‖f w‖) → (∀ (w : ℂ), w.im = a → N w ≤ C) → (∀ (w : ℂ), w.im = b → N w ≤ C) → (∃ c < Real.pi / (b - a), ∃ B, f =O[Filter.comap (fun w => |w.re|) Filter.atTop ⊓ Filter.principal (Complex.im ⁻¹' Set.Ioo a b)] fun w => Real.exp (B * Real.exp (c * |w.re|))) → ∀ {z : ℂ}, a ≤ z.im → z.im ≤ b → N z ≤ C

entries.name: CohnElkies.integrable_scaled_exp_change_Ioi
entries.statement: ∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] {R : ℝ}, 0 < R → ∀ (f : ℝ → E), MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume ↔ MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => (R * Real.exp v) • f (R * Real.exp v)) MeasureTheory.volume

entries.name: CohnElkies.integrable_scaled_norm_moment

entries.name: CohnElkies.integral_complexFrullaniKernel

entries.name: CohnElkies.integral_lowerWallisRegularizedPhaseKernel

entries.name: CohnElkies.lower_abs_log_coth_div_le
entries.statement: ∀ {x : ℝ}, 0 < x → |Real.log (CohnElkies.lowerCoth (Real.pi * x) / x)| ≤ 2 * (Real.pi * x) + |Real.log Real.pi| + 2 * |Real.log x|

entries.name: CohnElkies.lower_abs_log_sinh_le
entries.statement: ∀ {x : ℝ}, 0 < x → |Real.log (Real.sinh x)| ≤ x + |Real.log x|

entries.name: CohnElkies.lower_cosh_le_exp

entries.name: CohnElkies.lower_exp_abs_log_div_two_integrableOn_Ioi
entries.statement: ∀ {a : ℝ}, 0 < a → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp (-a * y) * |Real.log (y / 2)|) (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume

entries.name: CohnElkies.lower_exp_log_coth_div_integrable
entries.statement: ∀ {a : ℝ}, 0 < a → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (-a * |y|) * Real.log (CohnElkies.lowerCoth (Real.pi * |y| / 2) / (|y| / 2))) MeasureTheory.volume

entries.name: CohnElkies.lower_exp_log_coth_div_integrableOn_Ioi
entries.statement: ∀ {a : ℝ}, 0 < a → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp (-a * y) * Real.log (CohnElkies.lowerCoth (Real.pi * y / 2) / (y / 2))) (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume

entries.name: CohnElkies.lower_exp_log_sqrtFactor_integrable
entries.statement: ∀ {a c : ℝ}, 0 < a → 0 ≤ c → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => Real.exp (-a * |y|) * Real.log √(c ^ 2 + (y / 2) ^ 2)) MeasureTheory.volume

entries.name: CohnElkies.lower_exp_log_sqrtFactor_integrableOn_Ioi
entries.statement: ∀ {a c : ℝ}, 0 < a → 0 ≤ c → MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn (fun y => Real.exp (-a * y) * Real.log √(c ^ 2 + (y / 2) ^ 2)) (Set.Ioi 0) MeasureTheory.volume

entries.name: CohnElkies.lower_halfInteger_midpointRiemann_error
entries.statement: ∀ {T : ℝ}, T ≠ 0 → ∀ {ℓ : ℝ}, 0 < ℓ → ∀ (k : ℕ), |(ℓ * ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..↑k / ℓ, CohnElkies.lowerRiemannLog T x) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, CohnElkies.lowerRiemannLog T ((↑j + 1 / 2) / ℓ)| ≤ CohnElkies.lowerRiemannLog T (↑k / ℓ) - CohnElkies.lowerRiemannLog T 0

entries.name: CohnElkies.lower_integer_leftRiemann_error
entries.statement: ∀ {T : ℝ}, T ≠ 0 → ∀ {k : ℕ}, 0 < k → 0 ≤ (↑k * ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..1, CohnElkies.lowerRiemannLog T x) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, CohnElkies.lowerRiemannLog T (↑j / ↑k) ∧ (↑k * ∫ (x : ℝ) in 0..1, CohnElkies.lowerRiemannLog T x) - ∑ j ∈ Finset.range k, CohnElkies.lowerRiemannLog T (↑j / ↑k) ≤ CohnElkies.lowerRiemannLog T 1 - CohnElkies.lowerRiemannLog T 0

entries.name: CohnElkies.lower_positiveLogRatio_integrable
entries.statement: ∀ {A : ℝ}, 0 < A → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => max (Real.log (A / |y|)) 0) MeasureTheory.volume

entries.name: CohnElkies.lower_sinh_ge_exp_quarter
entries.statement: ∀ {x : ℝ}, 1 ≤ x → Real.exp x / 4 ≤ Real.sinh x

entries.name: CohnElkies.lower_sinh_le_exp

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptBinaryExponentError
entries.statement: ℕ → ℝ

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptBinaryExponentError_isLittleO
entries.statement: CohnElkies.manuscriptBinaryExponentError =o[Filter.atTop] fun x => 1

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptBinaryExponentError_tendsto
entries.statement: Filter.Tendsto CohnElkies.manuscriptBinaryExponentError Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptLinearProgram_eq_binary_error_rpow
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → 0 < CohnElkies.linearProgram d → CohnElkies.linearProgram d = 2 ^ (-(CohnElkies.criticalBinaryExponent + CohnElkies.manuscriptBinaryExponentError d) * ↑d)

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptLinearProgram_eq_canonicalBinaryRpow
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → 0 < CohnElkies.linearProgram d → CohnElkies.linearProgram d = 2 ^ (-(CohnElkies.criticalBinaryExponent + CohnElkies.manuscriptBinaryExponentError d) * ↑d)

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptLinearProgram_eq_canonicalPackingPow
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → CohnElkies.linearProgram d = (CohnElkies.criticalPackingBase + CohnElkies.manuscriptPackingRootError d) ^ d

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptLinearProgram_eq_packing_error_pow
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → CohnElkies.linearProgram d = (CohnElkies.criticalPackingBase + CohnElkies.manuscriptPackingRootError d) ^ d

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptPackingDeficit

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptPackingDeficit_le_criticalPackingBase
entries.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ), CohnElkies.manuscriptPackingDeficit d ≤ CohnElkies.criticalPackingBase

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptPackingDeficit_nonneg

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptPackingRootError_isLittleO

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptPackingRoot_sub_deficit_le
entries.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ), CohnElkies.criticalPackingBase - CohnElkies.manuscriptPackingDeficit d ≤ CohnElkies.linearProgram d ^ (↑d)⁻¹

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptPackingRoot_sub_deficit_pow_le
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → (CohnElkies.criticalPackingBase - CohnElkies.manuscriptPackingDeficit d) ^ d ≤ CohnElkies.linearProgram d

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptQuotientRootError

entries.statement: CohnElkies.manuscriptQuotientRootError =o[Filter.atTop] fun x => 1

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptQuotientRootInf_div_sqrt_eq
entries.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ), sInf (CohnElkies.manuscriptQuotientRootSet d) / √↑d = CohnElkies.normalizedProgram d

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptQuotientRootInf_div_sqrt_tendsto
entries.statement: CohnElkies.SharpQuotientAsymptotic → Filter.Tendsto (fun d => sInf (CohnElkies.manuscriptQuotientRootSet d) / √↑d) Filter.atTop (nhds Real.pi⁻¹)

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptQuotientRootInf_eq
entries.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ), sInf (CohnElkies.manuscriptQuotientRootSet d) = sInf (CohnElkies.quotientSet d) ^ (↑d)⁻¹

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptQuotientRootInf_eq_critical_add_error
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → sInf (CohnElkies.manuscriptQuotientRootSet d) = (Real.pi⁻¹ + CohnElkies.manuscriptQuotientRootError d) * √↑d

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptQuotientRootSet
entries.statement: ℕ → Set ℝ

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptQuotientRootSet_eq_image
entries.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ), CohnElkies.manuscriptQuotientRootSet d = (fun x => x ^ (↑d)⁻¹) '' CohnElkies.quotientSet d

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptQuotientRootSet_eq_literal
entries.statement: ∀ (d : ℕ), CohnElkies.manuscriptQuotientRootSet d = {q | ∃ f, CohnElkies.quotient f ^ (↑d)⁻¹ = q}

entries.name: CohnElkies.manuscriptUniversalQuotientBound
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → ∀ (f : CohnElkies.Admissible d), 2 ^ d / CohnElkies.unitBallVolume d * (CohnElkies.criticalPackingBase - CohnElkies.manuscriptPackingDeficit d) ^ d ≤ CohnElkies.quotient f

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinFrequency
entries.statement: ℝ → (ℝ → ℂ) → ℝ → ℂ

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinFrequency_eq_fourier
entries.statement: ∀ (ℓ : ℝ) (profile : ℝ → ℂ) (t : ℝ), CohnElkies.mellinFrequency ℓ profile t = FourierTransform.fourier (fun u => Real.exp (-ℓ * u) • profile (Real.exp (-u))) (-t / (2 * Real.pi))

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinInv_real_of_hermitian
entries.statement: ∀ (σ : ℝ) (F : ℂ → ℂ), (∀ (t : ℝ), (starRingEnd ℂ) (F (↑σ + ↑t * Complex.I)) = F (↑σ + ↑(-t) * Complex.I)) → ∀ {r : ℝ}, 0 < r → (mellinInv σ F r).im = 0

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinInversePower_conj
entries.statement: ∀ {r : ℝ}, 0 < r → ∀ (σ t : ℝ), (starRingEnd ℂ) (↑r ^ (-(↑σ + ↑t * Complex.I))) = ↑r ^ (-(↑σ + ↑(-t) * Complex.I))

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinMultiplier
entries.statement: ℝ → ℝ → ℂ

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinMultiplier_denominator_ne_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {ℓ : ℝ}, 0 < ℓ → ∀ (t : ℝ), Complex.Gamma ((↑ℓ + Complex.I * ↑t) / 2) ≠ 0

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinMultiplier_mul_minusSaddleSpectrum_neg
entries.statement: ∀ {ε ℓ : ℝ}, 0 < ℓ → ∀ (t : ℝ), CohnElkies.mellinMultiplier ℓ t * CohnElkies.minusSaddleSpectrum ε ℓ (-t) = CohnElkies.plusSaddleSpectrum ε ℓ t

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinMultiplier_mul_saddleEnvelope_neg
entries.statement: ∀ {ε ℓ : ℝ}, 0 < ℓ → ∀ (t : ℝ), CohnElkies.mellinMultiplier ℓ t * CohnElkies.saddleEnvelope ε ℓ (-t) = CohnElkies.saddleEnvelope ε ℓ t

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase
entries.statement: ℝ → ℂ → ℂ

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase_analyticOnNhd
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase ε) Set.univ

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase_continuous
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → Continuous (CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase ε)

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase_differentiable
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → Differentiable ℂ (CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase ε)

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase_imaginary
entries.statement: ∀ (ε u : ℝ), CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase ε (Complex.I * ↑u) = ↑(CohnElkies.realHyperbolicShellPhase ε u)

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase_neg
entries.statement: ∀ (ε : ℝ) (z : ℂ), CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase ε (-z) = CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase ε z

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase_neg_I
entries.statement: ∀ (ε : ℝ), CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase ε (-Complex.I) = ↑(CohnElkies.realHyperbolicShellPhase ε 1)

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase_ofReal
entries.statement: ∀ (ε t : ℝ), CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase ε ↑t = ↑(CohnElkies.realOscillatoryShellPhase ε t)

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase_real_conj
entries.statement: ∀ (ε t : ℝ), (starRingEnd ℂ) (CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase ε ↑t) = CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase ε ↑t

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase_shifted_re
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → ∀ (T u : ℝ), (CohnElkies.mellinShellPhase ε (↑T + Complex.I * ↑u)).re = (∫ (a : ℝ) in CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε..CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε, CohnElkies.shortShellDensity ε a * (Real.cos (a * T) * Real.cosh (a * u) - 1)) + ∫ (a : ℝ) in CohnElkies.shellLocation ε..CohnElkies.shellLocation ε + 1, CohnElkies.positiveShellDensity ε a * (Real.cos (a * T) * Real.cosh (a * u) - 1)

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellin_gaussianMellinPairingProfile
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ}, 0 < d → ∀ (f : CohnElkies.TestFunction d) (b : ℂ), 0 < b.re → 2 * b.re < ↑d → mellin (CohnElkies.gaussianMellinPairingProfile f) b = Complex.Gamma b * ∫ (x : CohnElkies.Euclidean d), f x * ↑‖x‖ ^ (-(2 * b))

entries.name: CohnElkies.mellin_gaussianMellinPairingProfile_fourier
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (f : CohnElkies.TestFunction d) (b : ℂ), mellin (CohnElkies.gaussianMellinPairingProfile (FourierTransform.fourier f)) b = ↑Real.pi ^ (↑d / 2) * (↑(Real.pi ^ 2) ^ (b - ↑d / 2) * mellin (CohnElkies.gaussianMellinPairingProfile f) (↑d / 2 - b))

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusPolynomial
entries.statement: ℝ → ℂ → ℂ

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusPolynomial_add_sub
entries.statement: ∀ (ε : ℝ) (z w : ℂ), CohnElkies.minusPolynomial ε (z + w) - CohnElkies.minusPolynomial ε z = w * (2 * z - Complex.I * (1 + 3 * z ^ 2)) + w ^ 2 * (1 - 3 * Complex.I * z) - Complex.I * w ^ 3

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusPolynomial_conj
entries.statement: ∀ (ε : ℝ) (z : ℂ), (starRingEnd ℂ) (CohnElkies.minusPolynomial ε z) = CohnElkies.plusPolynomial ε ((starRingEnd ℂ) z)

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusPolynomial_imaginary
entries.statement: ∀ (ε u : ℝ), CohnElkies.minusPolynomial ε (Complex.I * ↑u) = ↑(CohnElkies.beta ε + (1 - u) * (1 + u) ^ 2)

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusPolynomial_imaginary_cubic_growth_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ε u : ℝ}, 0 < ε → 1 + ε / 4 ≤ u → (1 + |u|) ^ 3 ≤ (9 / CohnElkies.beta ε + 6) * ‖CohnElkies.minusPolynomial ε (Complex.I * ↑u)‖

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusPolynomial_imaginary_norm_ge_three_beta
entries.statement: ∀ {ε u : ℝ}, 0 < ε → 1 + ε / 4 ≤ u → 3 * CohnElkies.beta ε ≤ ‖CohnElkies.minusPolynomial ε (Complex.I * ↑u)‖

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusPolynomial_imaginary_re_neg
entries.statement: ∀ {ε u : ℝ}, 0 < ε → 1 + ε / 4 ≤ u → (CohnElkies.minusPolynomial ε (Complex.I * ↑u)).re < 0

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusPolynomial_neg
entries.statement: ∀ (ε : ℝ) (z : ℂ), CohnElkies.minusPolynomial ε (-z) = CohnElkies.plusPolynomial ε z

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusPolynomial_neg_I
entries.statement: ∀ (ε : ℝ), CohnElkies.minusPolynomial ε (-Complex.I) = ↑(CohnElkies.beta ε)

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusPolynomial_translation_norm_le
entries.statement: ∀ (ε u T : ℝ), ‖CohnElkies.minusPolynomial ε (↑T + Complex.I * ↑u) - CohnElkies.minusPolynomial ε (Complex.I * ↑u)‖ ≤ 9 * (1 + |u|) ^ 2 * (|T| + |T| ^ 3)

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleCriticalLogProfile_eq_fourierInv
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ} {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (f : CohnElkies.TestFunction d), (∀ (x : CohnElkies.Euclidean d), f x = CohnElkies.minusSaddleFunction ε d x) → CohnElkies.radialCriticalLogProfile hd f = FourierTransformInv.fourierInv (CohnElkies.minusSaddleFourierData ε (↑d / 2))

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleRegularPart
entries.statement: ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℂ → ℂ

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleRegularPart_analyticOnNhd
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → ∀ (ℓ : ℝ) (N : ℕ), AnalyticOnNhd ℂ (CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleRegularPart ε ℓ N) (CohnElkies.saddleFinitePoleHalfPlane N)

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleRegularPart_differentiableOn
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → ∀ (ℓ : ℝ) (N : ℕ), DifferentiableOn ℂ (CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleRegularPart ε ℓ N) (CohnElkies.saddleFinitePoleHalfPlane N)

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleRegularPart_eq_on_punctured
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → ∀ (ℓ : ℝ) (N : ℕ) {z : ℂ}, z ∈ CohnElkies.saddleFinitePoleHalfPlane N → CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleRegularPart ε ℓ N =ᶠ[nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ] CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleSubtraction ε ℓ N

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleRegularPart_eq_subtraction_of_not_pole
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → ∀ (ℓ : ℝ) (N : ℕ) {z : ℂ}, z ∈ CohnElkies.saddleFinitePoleHalfPlane N → (∀ (n : ℕ), z ≠ -↑(2 * n)) → CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleRegularPart ε ℓ N z = CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleSubtraction ε ℓ N z

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleRegularPart_meromorphicNFOn
entries.statement: ∀ (ε ℓ : ℝ) (N : ℕ), MeromorphicNFOn (CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleRegularPart ε ℓ N) (CohnElkies.saddleFinitePoleHalfPlane N)

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleRemaining
entries.statement: ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℕ → ℂ → ℂ

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleRemaining_differentiableAt_pole
entries.statement: ∀ (ε ℓ : ℝ) (N n : ℕ), DifferentiableAt ℂ (CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleRemaining ε ℓ N n) (-↑(2 * n))

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleSubtraction
entries.statement: ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℂ → ℂ

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleSubtraction_differentiableAt_of_not_pole
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → ∀ (ℓ : ℝ) (N : ℕ) {z : ℂ}, (∀ (n : ℕ), z ≠ -↑(2 * n)) → DifferentiableAt ℂ (CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleSubtraction ε ℓ N) z

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleSubtraction_eventually_eq_poleRegular
entries.statement: ∀ (ε ℓ : ℝ) (N n : ℕ), n ≤ N → CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleSubtraction ε ℓ N =ᶠ[nhdsWithin (-↑(2 * n)) {-↑(2 * n)}ᶜ] fun z => CohnElkies.minusSaddleNthPoleRegularPart ε ℓ n z - CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleRemaining ε ℓ N n z

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleSubtraction_meromorphic
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → ∀ (ℓ : ℝ) (N : ℕ), Meromorphic (CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleSubtraction ε ℓ N)

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleSubtraction_tendsto_at_pole
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → ∀ (ℓ : ℝ) (N n : ℕ), n ≤ N → Filter.Tendsto (CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleSubtraction ε ℓ N) (nhdsWithin (-↑(2 * n)) {-↑(2 * n)}ᶜ) (nhds (CohnElkies.minusSaddleNthPoleRegularPart ε ℓ n (-↑(2 * n)) - CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleRemaining ε ℓ N n (-↑(2 * n))))

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleSubtraction_tendsto_of_mem
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ}, 0 < ε → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → ∀ (ℓ : ℝ) (N : ℕ) {z : ℂ}, z ∈ CohnElkies.saddleFinitePoleHalfPlane N → ∃ c, Filter.Tendsto (CohnElkies.minusSaddleFinitePoleSubtraction ε ℓ N) (nhdsWithin z {z}ᶜ) (nhds c)

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleFiniteRapidContourIntegrand
entries.statement: ℝ → ℝ → ℕ → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ

entries.name: CohnElkies.minusSaddleFiniteRapidContourIntegrand_boundary_rectangle

entries.name: CohnElkies.negativeHalfline_le_of_fourierInversion

entries.name: CohnElkies.no_antiFourierWitness_of_fourierInversion_lt_half
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) {R : ℝ}, 0 < R → ∀ (w : CohnElkies.AntiFourierWitness d R) {a : ℝ}, 0 < a → ∀ (Z : ℝ → ℂ), (∀ (v : ℝ), ↑(CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile hd w.function R v) = ↑(Real.exp (a * v)) * FourierTransformInv.fourierInv (fun ξ => Z (2 * Real.pi * ξ)) v) → ((2 * Real.pi)⁻¹ * ∫ (s : ℝ), ‖Z s‖) / a < 1 / 2 → False

entries.name: CohnElkies.norm_stripRegularizedHolomorphicPoissonKernelDeriv_neg
entries.statement: ∀ {ℓ : ℝ}, 0 < ℓ → ∀ {z : ℂ}, z ∈ Complex.im ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-ℓ) ℓ → ∀ (y : ℝ), ‖CohnElkies.stripRegularizedHolomorphicPoissonKernelDeriv ℓ z y‖ ≤ Real.pi * Real.exp (-(Real.pi * (z.re - y) / (2 * ℓ))) / (4 * ℓ ^ 2 * Real.sin (Real.pi * (z.im + ℓ) / (2 * ℓ)) ^ 2)

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (g : CohnElkies.TestFunction d) (R v : ℝ), CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile hd g R v = CohnElkies.radialSurfaceArea d / CohnElkies.radialL1Mass g * (R * Real.exp v * ((R * Real.exp v) ^ (d - 1) * (CohnElkies.radialProfile hd g (R * Real.exp v)).re))

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile_integrable
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (g : CohnElkies.TestFunction d), CohnElkies.IsRadial g → ∀ {R : ℝ}, 0 < R → MeasureTheory.Integrable (CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile hd g R) MeasureTheory.volume

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile_nonneg_of_exterior
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (g : CohnElkies.TestFunction d), g ≠ 0 → ∀ {R : ℝ}, 0 < R → (∀ (x : CohnElkies.Euclidean d), R ≤ ‖x‖ → 0 ≤ (g x).re) → ∀ (v : ℝ), 0 ≤ v → 0 ≤ CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile hd g R v

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile_ofReal
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (f : CohnElkies.TestFunction d), CohnElkies.IsRealValued f → ∀ (R v : ℝ), ↑(CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile hd f R v) = ↑(CohnElkies.radialSurfaceArea d / CohnElkies.radialL1Mass f) * ↑((R * Real.exp v) ^ d) * CohnElkies.radialProfile hd f (R * Real.exp v)

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile_weighted_fourier_integrable
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (f : CohnElkies.TestFunction d), CohnElkies.IsRealValued f → ∀ {R : ℝ}, 0 < R → ∀ {a : ℝ}, a < ↑d → MeasureTheory.Integrable (FourierTransform.fourier fun v => ↑(Real.exp (-a * v)) * ↑(CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile hd f R v)) MeasureTheory.volume

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile_weighted_integrable
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (f : CohnElkies.TestFunction d), CohnElkies.IsRadial f → CohnElkies.IsRealValued f → f 0 = 0 → ∀ {R : ℝ}, 0 < R → ∀ {a : ℝ}, a < ↑d + 2 → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun v => ↑(Real.exp (-a * v)) * ↑(CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile hd f R v)) MeasureTheory.volume

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile_weighted_ofReal
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (f : CohnElkies.TestFunction d), CohnElkies.IsRealValued f → ∀ (R a v : ℝ), ↑(Real.exp (-a * v)) * ↑(CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile hd f R v) = ↑(CohnElkies.radialSurfaceArea d / CohnElkies.radialL1Mass f * R ^ d) * ↑(Real.exp ((↑d - a) * v)) * CohnElkies.radialProfile hd f (R * Real.exp v)

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip
entries.statement: {d : ℕ} → 0 < d → CohnElkies.TestFunction d → ℝ → ℂ → ℂ

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip_bottom_norm_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (f : CohnElkies.TestFunction d), f ≠ 0 → ∀ (R y : ℝ), ‖CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip hd f R (↑y - Complex.I * ↑(↑d / 2))‖ = CohnElkies.radialSurfaceArea d / CohnElkies.radialL1Mass f * Real.exp (↑d * Real.log R) * ‖mellin (CohnElkies.radialProfile hd f) (-(Complex.I * ↑y))‖

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip_bottom_norm_le_gamma
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (f : CohnElkies.TestFunction d), CohnElkies.IsRadial f → f 0 = 0 → FourierTransform.fourier f = -f → f ≠ 0 → ∀ (R : ℝ), 0 < R → ∀ (y : ℝ), y ≠ 0 → ‖CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip hd f R (↑y - Complex.I * ↑(↑d / 2))‖ ≤ Real.exp (↑d / 2 * Real.log (Real.pi * R ^ 2) + Real.log ‖Complex.Gamma (-Complex.I * ↑y / 2)‖ - Real.log ‖Complex.Gamma (↑(↑d / 2) + Complex.I * ↑y / 2)‖)

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip_diffContOnCl
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (f : CohnElkies.TestFunction d), CohnElkies.IsRadial f → f 0 = 0 → ∀ (R : ℝ), DiffContOnCl ℂ (CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip hd f R) (Complex.im ⁻¹' Set.Ioo (-(↑d / 2)) (↑d / 2))

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip_shifted_eq_fourier
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (f : CohnElkies.TestFunction d), CohnElkies.IsRealValued f → ∀ (R : ℝ), 0 < R → ∀ (a t : ℝ), CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip hd f R (↑t + Complex.I * ↑(↑d / 2 - a)) = FourierTransform.fourier (fun v => ↑(Real.exp (-a * v)) * ↑(CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile hd f R v)) (t / (2 * Real.pi))

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip_shifted_fourier_inversion
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (f : CohnElkies.TestFunction d), CohnElkies.IsRadial f → CohnElkies.IsRealValued f → f 0 = 0 → ∀ {R : ℝ}, 0 < R → ∀ {a : ℝ}, a < ↑d → ∀ (v : ℝ), ↑(CohnElkies.normalizedRadialLogProfile hd f R v) = ↑(Real.exp (a * v)) * FourierTransformInv.fourierInv (fun ξ => CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip hd f R (↑(2 * Real.pi * ξ) + Complex.I * ↑(↑d / 2 - a))) v

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip_shifted_integrable
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (f : CohnElkies.TestFunction d), CohnElkies.IsRealValued f → ∀ {R : ℝ}, 0 < R → ∀ {a : ℝ}, a < ↑d → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t => CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip hd f R (↑t + Complex.I * ↑(↑d / 2 - a))) MeasureTheory.volume

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip_top_norm_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (f : CohnElkies.TestFunction d), f ≠ 0 → ∀ (R y : ℝ), ‖CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip hd f R (↑y + Complex.I * ↑(↑d / 2))‖ = CohnElkies.radialSurfaceArea d / CohnElkies.radialL1Mass f * ‖mellin (CohnElkies.radialProfile hd f) (↑d - Complex.I * ↑y)‖

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip_top_norm_le_one
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (f : CohnElkies.TestFunction d), CohnElkies.IsRadial f → f ≠ 0 → ∀ (R y : ℝ), ‖CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip hd f R (↑y + Complex.I * ↑(↑d / 2))‖ ≤ 1

entries.name: CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip_uniform_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (f : CohnElkies.TestFunction d), CohnElkies.IsRadial f → f 0 = 0 → ∀ (R : ℝ), ∃ C, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ (z : ℂ), -(↑d / 2) ≤ z.im → z.im ≤ ↑d / 2 → ‖CohnElkies.normalizedRadialMellinStrip hd f R z‖ ≤ C

entries.name: CohnElkies.plusPolynomial_add_sub

entries.name: CohnElkies.plusPolynomial_imaginary_cubic_growth_le

entries.statement: ∀ {ε u : ℝ}, 0 < ε → -1 ≤ u → CohnElkies.beta ε ≤ ‖CohnElkies.plusPolynomial ε (Complex.I * ↑u)‖

entries.name: CohnElkies.plusPolynomial_negative_imaginary_residue

entries.name: CohnElkies.plusPolynomial_translation_norm_le

entries.name: CohnElkies.plusSaddleCriticalLogProfile_eq_fourierInv

entries.name: CohnElkies.plusSaddleFinitePoleSubtraction_eventually_eq_poleRegular

entries.statement: ∀ {ε ℓ r : ℝ}, 0 < ε → 0 < ℓ → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → 0 < r → ∀ (N : ℕ), CohnElkies.plusSaddleProfile ε ℓ r = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), CohnElkies.plusSaddlePoleResidue ε ℓ n * ↑(r ^ (2 * n)) + CohnElkies.plusSaddleTaylorRemainder ε ℓ N r

entries.statement: ∀ {ε ℓ r u : ℝ}, 0 < ε → 0 < ℓ → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → 0 < r → -1 < u → CohnElkies.plusSaddleProfile ε ℓ r = ↑(ℓ / (2 * Real.pi)) * ∫ (T : ℝ), CohnElkies.saddleMellinInversePower r (CohnElkies.saddleSourceMellinContour ℓ u T) * CohnElkies.plusSaddleMellinData ε ℓ (CohnElkies.saddleSourceMellinContour ℓ u T)

entries.name: CohnElkies.plusSaddleProfile_eq_squaredTaylor
entries.statement: ∀ {ε ℓ : ℝ}, 0 < ε → 0 < ℓ → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → ∀ (N : ℕ) {r : ℝ}, 0 ≤ r → CohnElkies.plusSaddleProfile ε ℓ r = CohnElkies.saddleSquaredResiduePolynomial (CohnElkies.plusSaddlePoleResidue ε ℓ) N (r ^ 2) + CohnElkies.plusSaddleSquaredRemainder ε ℓ N (r ^ 2)

entries.name: CohnElkies.plusSaddleProfile_exp_eq_centeredIntegral

entries.name: CohnElkies.plusSaddleProfile_re_pos_at_sourceSaddle_of_gaussian_error
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ} {d : ℕ} {u : ℝ}, 0 < ε → 0 < d → -1 < u → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → 0 < CohnElkies.saddleSourceGaussianVariance ε (↑d / 2) u → ‖(∫ (T : ℝ), CohnElkies.saddleSourceCenteredPlusIntegrand ε (↑d / 2) u (CohnElkies.saddleLogRadius ε d u) T) - ∫ (T : ℝ), CohnElkies.saddleSourceGaussianPlusIntegrand ε (↑d / 2) u T‖ < (∫ (T : ℝ), CohnElkies.saddleSourceGaussianPlusIntegrand ε (↑d / 2) u T).re → 0 < (CohnElkies.plusSaddleProfile ε (↑d / 2) (Real.exp (CohnElkies.saddleLogRadius ε d u))).re

entries.name: CohnElkies.plusSaddleProfile_re_pos_of_relative_residue_bounds
entries.statement: ∀ {ε ℓ r : ℝ}, 0 < ε → 0 < ℓ → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → 0 < r → ∀ (N : ℕ), Real.exp (CohnElkies.saddleSmallRadiusVariable ε r) * |∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), (-CohnElkies.saddleSmallRadiusVariable ε r) ^ n / ↑n.factorial * CohnElkies.plusSaddleSmallRadiusCoefficient ε ℓ n - Real.exp (-CohnElkies.saddleSmallRadiusVariable ε r)| < 1 / 2 → Real.exp (CohnElkies.saddleSmallRadiusVariable ε r) * ‖CohnElkies.plusSaddleTaylorRemainder ε ℓ N r / ↑(CohnElkies.saddleOriginValue ε ℓ)‖ < 1 / 2 → 0 < (CohnElkies.plusSaddleProfile ε ℓ r).re

entries.statement: ∀ {ε ℓ : ℝ}, 0 < ε → 0 < ℓ → ∀ (n : ℕ), 2 * ↑n ≤ ℓ → ∀ (C : ℝ), 0 ≤ C → |ℓ * (CohnElkies.realHyperbolicShellPhase ε (1 + 2 * ↑n / ℓ) - CohnElkies.realHyperbolicShellPhase ε 1) - 2 * ↑n * CohnElkies.saddleShellDerivativeOne ε| ≤ C * ↑n ^ 2 / ℓ → |CohnElkies.plusSaddleSmallRadiusCoefficient ε ℓ n - 1| ≤ (C * ↑n ^ 2 / ℓ + 18 / CohnElkies.beta ε * (↑n / ℓ)) * Real.exp (C * ↑n ^ 2 / ℓ)

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleEnvelope_continuous

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleEnvelope_vertical_polynomial_bound

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleExpSeries_alternating_tail_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {y : ℝ}, 0 ≤ y → ∀ (m : ℕ), 2 * y ≤ ↑m + 1 → |Real.exp (-y) - ∑ n ∈ Finset.range m, (-y) ^ n / ↑n.factorial| ≤ 2 * (y ^ m / ↑m.factorial)

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleExpSeries_firstMoment_hasSum

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleExpSeries_hasSum

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleExpSeries_polynomialMoment_hasSum

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleExpSeries_polynomialMoment_sum_range_le
entries.statement: ∀ {y : ℝ}, 0 ≤ y → ∀ (N : ℕ), ∑ n ∈ Finset.range N, (↑n + ↑n ^ 2) * (y ^ n / ↑n.factorial) ≤ (2 * y + y ^ 2) * Real.exp y

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleExpSeries_secondFallingMoment_hasSum

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleExpSeries_tail_term_le_geometric
entries.statement: ∀ {y : ℝ}, 0 ≤ y → ∀ (m : ℕ), 2 * y ≤ ↑m + 1 → ∀ (k : ℕ), y ^ (m + k) / ↑(m + k).factorial ≤ y ^ m / ↑m.factorial * (1 / 2) ^ k

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleExpSeries_term_le_exp_mul_half_pow
entries.statement: ∀ {y : ℝ}, 0 ≤ y → ∀ (m : ℕ), y ^ m / ↑m.factorial ≤ Real.exp (2 * y) * (1 / 2) ^ m

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleExponential_cubic_tail_integral_le
entries.statement: ∀ {k R : ℝ}, 6 ≤ k → 0 ≤ R → ∫ (T : ℝ) in CohnElkies.saddleGaussianTailSet R, CohnElkies.saddleGaussianTailWeight T * Real.exp (-k * |T|) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(k / 4) * R) * (2 / (k / 4))

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleExponential_weighted_integral_le_rescaled
entries.statement: ∀ {k : ℝ}, 0 < k → ∫ (T : ℝ), CohnElkies.saddleGaussianTailWeight T * Real.exp (-k * |T|) ≤ 2 * max 1 ((k / 6) ^ 3)⁻¹ * (2 / (k / 2))

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleFiniteGaussianPoleWeighted_horizontalStrip_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {r A B : ℝ}, 0 < r → A ≤ B → ∀ (c : ℕ → ℂ) (N : ℕ), ∃ C, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ a ∈ Set.Icc A B, ∀ (t : ℝ), 1 ≤ |t| → |t| * ‖CohnElkies.saddleMellinInversePower r (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), c n * CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative n (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleFiniteGaussianPoleWeighted_shiftedLine_integrable
entries.statement: ∀ {r a : ℝ}, 0 < r → ∀ (c : ℕ → ℂ) (N : ℕ), (∀ (n : ℕ), a ≠ -↑(2 * n)) → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t => ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), CohnElkies.saddleMellinInversePower r (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I) * (c n * CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative n (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I))) MeasureTheory.volume

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleFiniteGaussianPoleWeighted_shiftedLine_integral
entries.statement: ∀ {r a : ℝ}, 0 < r → ∀ (c : ℕ → ℂ) (N : ℕ), (∀ (n : ℕ), a ≠ -↑(2 * n)) → ∫ (t : ℝ), ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), CohnElkies.saddleMellinInversePower r (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I) * (c n * CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative n (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I)) = ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), c n * ∫ (t : ℝ), CohnElkies.saddleMellinInversePower r (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I) * CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative n (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I)

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleFiniteGaussianPoleWeighted_vertical_integral_jump
entries.statement: ∀ {r A B : ℝ}, 0 < r → ∀ (c : ℕ → ℂ) (N : ℕ), (∀ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), A < -↑(2 * n) ∧ -↑(2 * n) < B) → (∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), c n * ∫ (t : ℝ), CohnElkies.saddleMellinInversePower r (↑B + ↑t * Complex.I) * CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative n (↑B + ↑t * Complex.I)) - ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), c n * ∫ (t : ℝ), CohnElkies.saddleMellinInversePower r (↑A + ↑t * Complex.I) * CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative n (↑A + ↑t * Complex.I) = ↑(2 * Real.pi) * ∑ n ∈ Finset.range (N + 1), c n * ↑(r ^ (2 * n))

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGamma_eq_nthPoleNumerator_div
entries.statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} {z : ℂ}, z ∈ CohnElkies.saddlePoleStrip n → z ≠ -↑(2 * n) → Complex.Gamma (z / 2) = CohnElkies.saddleNthGammaPoleNumerator n z / (z + ↑(2 * n))

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGamma_residue_neg_even

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGamma_shiftedLine_polynomial_bound
entries.statement: ∀ (a : ℝ) {t : ℝ}, 1 ≤ |t| → ∀ (k m : ℕ), 0 < a / 2 + ↑k → |t| ^ m * ‖Complex.Gamma ((↑a + ↑t * Complex.I) / 2)‖ ≤ 2 ^ (k + m) * Real.Gamma (a / 2 + ↑(k + m))

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative_eq_inv_add_slope

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative_shiftedLine_bound

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative_shiftedLine_integrable
entries.statement: ∀ {a : ℝ} (n : ℕ), a ≠ -↑(2 * n) → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t => CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative n (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I)) MeasureTheory.volume

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative_shiftedLine_norm
entries.statement: ∀ (a t : ℝ) (n : ℕ), ‖CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative n (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I)‖ = Real.exp ((a + ↑(2 * n)) ^ 2 - t ^ 2) / ‖↑a + ↑t * Complex.I + ↑(2 * n)‖

entries.statement: ∀ {a r : ℝ} (n : ℕ), a ≠ -↑(2 * n) → 0 < r → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun t => CohnElkies.saddleMellinInversePower r (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I) * CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative n (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I)) MeasureTheory.volume

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative_vertical_integral_jump
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) {A B : ℝ}, A < -↑(2 * n) → -↑(2 * n) < B → (∫ (t : ℝ), CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative n (↑B + ↑t * Complex.I)) - ∫ (t : ℝ), CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative n (↑A + ↑t * Complex.I) = ↑(2 * Real.pi)

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative_weighted_horizontalStrip_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {r A B : ℝ}, 0 < r → A ≤ B → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∃ C, 0 ≤ C ∧ ∀ a ∈ Set.Icc A B, ∀ (t : ℝ), 1 ≤ |t| → |t| * ‖CohnElkies.saddleMellinInversePower r (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I) * CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative n (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleShiftedSlope_boundary_rectangle
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A B T : ℝ), (((∫ (a : ℝ) in A..B, CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleSlope (↑a + ↑(-T) * Complex.I + ↑(2 * n))) - ∫ (a : ℝ) in A..B, CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleSlope (↑a + ↑T * Complex.I + ↑(2 * n))) + Complex.I * ∫ (t : ℝ) in -T..T, CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleSlope (↑B + ↑t * Complex.I + ↑(2 * n))) - Complex.I * ∫ (t : ℝ) in -T..T, CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleSlope (↑A + ↑t * Complex.I + ↑(2 * n)) = 0

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleShiftedSlope_differentiable
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), Differentiable ℂ fun z => CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleSlope (z + ↑(2 * n))

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleShiftedSlope_horizontalIntegral_tendsto_zero
entries.statement: ∀ {A B : ℝ}, A ≤ B → ∀ (n : ℕ) (s : ℝ), |s| = 1 → Filter.Tendsto (fun T => ∫ (a : ℝ) in A..B, CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleSlope (↑a + ↑(s * T) * Complex.I + ↑(2 * n))) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleShiftedSlope_symmetric_intervalIntegral
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) {a : ℝ}, a ≠ -↑(2 * n) → ∀ (T : ℝ), ∫ (t : ℝ) in -T..T, CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleSlope (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I + ↑(2 * n)) = (∫ (t : ℝ) in -T..T, CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative n (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I)) - ∫ (t : ℝ) in -T..T, (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I + ↑(2 * n))⁻¹

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleShiftedSlope_symmetric_intervalIntegral_tendsto_neg
entries.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) {a : ℝ}, a < -↑(2 * n) → Filter.Tendsto (fun T => ∫ (t : ℝ) in -T..T, CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleSlope (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I + ↑(2 * n))) Filter.atTop (nhds ((∫ (t : ℝ), CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative n (↑a + ↑t * Complex.I)) - -↑Real.pi))

entries.statement: ∀ {r : ℝ}, 0 < r → ∀ (n : ℕ) (A B T : ℝ), (((∫ (a : ℝ) in A..B, CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleWeightedCorrection r n (↑a + ↑(-T) * Complex.I)) - ∫ (a : ℝ) in A..B, CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleWeightedCorrection r n (↑a + ↑T * Complex.I)) + Complex.I * ∫ (t : ℝ) in -T..T, CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleWeightedCorrection r n (↑B + ↑t * Complex.I)) - Complex.I * ∫ (t : ℝ) in -T..T, CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleWeightedCorrection r n (↑A + ↑t * Complex.I) = 0

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleWeightedCorrection_horizontalIntegral_tendsto_zero

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleWeightedCorrection_shiftedLine_integrable

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleWeightedCorrection_vertical_integral_eq
entries.statement: ∀ {r A B : ℝ}, 0 < r → ∀ (n : ℕ), A ≤ B → A ≠ -↑(2 * n) → B ≠ -↑(2 * n) → ∫ (t : ℝ), CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleWeightedCorrection r n (↑B + ↑t * Complex.I) = ∫ (t : ℝ), CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleWeightedCorrection r n (↑A + ↑t * Complex.I)

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleWeightedRepresentative_eq_pole_add_correction
entries.statement: ∀ {r : ℝ} (n : ℕ) {z : ℂ}, z + ↑(2 * n) ≠ 0 → CohnElkies.saddleMellinInversePower r z * CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative n z = CohnElkies.saddleMellinInversePower r (-↑(2 * n)) * CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleRepresentative n z + CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleWeightedCorrection r n z

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleGaussianPoleWeightedRepresentative_shiftedLine_integral_eq

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleSourceAdmissible_normalizedCost
entries.statement: ∀ {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) {d : ℕ} (hd : 0 < d) (horder : CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε) {R : ℝ} (hR : 0 < R) (fminus fplus : CohnElkies.TestFunction d) (hminus : ∀ (x : CohnElkies.Euclidean d), fminus x = CohnElkies.minusSaddleFunction ε d x) (hplus : ∀ (x : CohnElkies.Euclidean d), fplus x = CohnElkies.plusSaddleFunction ε d x) (hplusnonneg : ∀ (x : CohnElkies.Euclidean d), 0 ≤ (CohnElkies.plusSaddleFunction ε d x).re) (hminusoutside : ∀ (x : CohnElkies.Euclidean d), R ≤ ‖x‖ → (CohnElkies.minusSaddleFunction ε d x).re ≤ 0), CohnElkies.normalizedCost (CohnElkies.saddleSourceAdmissible hε hd horder hR fminus fplus hminus hplus hplusnonneg hminusoutside) = R / √↑d

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleSourceWeightedCosineQuadraticRemainder_integral_eq
entries.statement: ∀ (w : ℝ → ℝ) {b c : ℝ}, b ≤ c → ContinuousOn w (Set.Icc b c) → ∀ (u T : ℝ), ∫ (a : ℝ) in b..c, ↑(w a) * CohnElkies.saddleSourceCosineQuadraticRemainder a u T = ((∫ (a : ℝ) in b..c, ↑(w a) * (Complex.cos (↑a * (↑T + Complex.I * ↑u)) - 1)) - ∫ (a : ℝ) in b..c, ↑(w a) * (↑(Real.cosh (u * a)) - 1)) + Complex.I * ↑(T * ∫ (a : ℝ) in b..c, w a * a * Real.sinh (u * a)) + ↑(T ^ 2 / 2 * ∫ (a : ℝ) in b..c, w a * a ^ 2 * Real.cosh (u * a))

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleSource_firstBranch_normalized_tail_bound
entries.statement: ∀ {ε ℓ u z C : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 / 4 → 0 < ℓ → -1 < u → u ≤ 1 + ε / 2 → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → (∀ a ∈ Set.Icc (CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε) (CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε), 0 ≤ CohnElkies.shortMargin ε a) → 0 < CohnElkies.saddleSourceGaussianVariance ε ℓ u → 0 < C → (1 + u) * CohnElkies.saddleSourceGaussianVariance ε ℓ u ≤ C → 0 ≤ z → 6 ≤ ε * ℓ / (2 * Real.exp 1) / (1 + u) → 6 ≤ ε * ℓ / (2 * Real.exp 1) → √(ℓ * CohnElkies.saddleSourceGaussianVariance ε ℓ u) * ∫ (T : ℝ) in CohnElkies.saddleGaussianTailSet (z / √(ℓ * CohnElkies.saddleSourceGaussianVariance ε ℓ u)), CohnElkies.saddleGaussianTailWeight T * Real.exp (-CohnElkies.saddleSourceContourDamping ε ℓ u T) ≤ 4 * √(Real.pi * C / (ε / (2 * Real.exp 1))) * Real.exp (-(ε / (2 * Real.exp 1) / (4 * C)) * z ^ 2) + 16 / (ε / (2 * Real.exp 1)) * √(C / (ℓ * (1 + u)))

entries.statement: ∀ {ε ℓ u : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 / 4 → 0 < ℓ → -1 < u → u ≤ 1 + ε / 2 → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → (∀ a ∈ Set.Icc (CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε) (CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε), 0 ≤ CohnElkies.shortMargin ε a) → MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun T => CohnElkies.saddleGaussianTailWeight T * Real.exp (-CohnElkies.saddleSourceContourDamping ε ℓ u T)) MeasureTheory.volume

entries.name: CohnElkies.saddleSource_firstBranch_weighted_tail_le
entries.statement: ∀ {ε ℓ u R : ℝ}, 0 < ε → ε ≤ 1 / 4 → 0 < ℓ → -1 < u → u ≤ 1 + ε / 2 → CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε ≤ CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε → (∀ a ∈ Set.Icc (CohnElkies.shortCutoff ε) (CohnElkies.shortEndpoint ε), 0 ≤ CohnElkies.shortMargin ε a) → 0 ≤ R → 6 ≤ ε * ℓ / (2 * Real.exp 1) / (1 + u) → 6 ≤ ε * ℓ / (2 * Real.exp 1) → ∫ (T : ℝ) in CohnElkies.saddleGaussianTailSet R, CohnElkies.saddleGaussianTailWeight T * Real.exp (-CohnElkies.saddleSourceContourDamping ε ℓ u T) ≤ 2 * Real.exp (-(ε * ℓ / (2 * Real.exp 1) / (1 + u) / 4) * R ^ 2) * √(Real.pi / (ε * ℓ / (2 * Real.exp 1) / (1 + u) / 4)) + 2 * Real.exp (-(ε * ℓ / (2 * Real.exp 1) / 4) * R) * (2 / (ε * ℓ / (2 * Real.exp 1) / 4))

entries.name: SpherePacking.ForMathlib.Fourier.fourier_precompose_linear_equivalence
entries.statement: ∀ {V : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup V] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [inst_2 : FiniteDimensional ℝ V] [inst_3 : MeasurableSpace V] [inst_4 : BorelSpace V] (A : V ≃ₗ[ℝ] V) (f : V → ℂ) (w : V), FourierTransform.fourier (fun x => f (A x)) w = |LinearMap.det ↑A|⁻¹ • FourierTransform.fourier f ((LinearMap.adjoint ↑A.symm) w)
